exposure: Intraperitoneal irrigation with saline at body temperature
outcome: VAS pain scores at 6 and 24 hours
White blood cell (WBC) count at 6 and 24 hours
finding: While 24-hour leukocyte count was lower in the saline irrigation group, 24-hour VAS pain scores were higher, and patients with previous cesarean sections who received saline irrigation had higher flatulence rates; further research is needed to determine the optimal method for reducing postoperative pain and promoting bowel function.
